method.arrivals: Partition acknowledgment-counter differences summed over producers, using nominal seconds 28--58 and actual endpoint scrape times per producer. Not exact broker-arrival timestamps.
method.task_capacity: Processing count difference / processing-time-sum difference = 1 / mean local processing seconds. Excludes polling, output/evidence bookkeeping, lag collection and commits.
method.effective_capacity: Completed-attempt counter difference / actual scrape elapsed seconds in selected calibration intervals; intervals are pooled by total completions / total observed time.
method.selection: Nonoverlapping 60-second evaluation intervals after second 60, before production stops. Fresh counters, fixed ownership/incarnation, no resets, valid contiguous backlog; 10-second throughput CV <= 0.10; minimum owner processing backlog >= max(100, 2 * observed msg/s). Backlog checks include the preceding 10 seconds. These sampled conditions are consistent with sustained work availability, not proof of continuous busyness.
method.reference_range: Minimum and maximum eligible-window rates describe observed variability, not confidence bounds. Underloaded intervals provide demonstrated throughput only, not a capacity ceiling.
method.screen: Sum of measured partition rates for each candidate consumer compared with its reference capacity. Positive headroom is required for accumulated work to drain. A margin, deadline model and transfer cost require further validation.
method.scope: Offline retrospective diagnosis of existing trials. No new live run, no fitted predictor, and no reclassification of original performance outcomes.
